[[File:Kashyyyk_clarion.png|thumb|200px|A Kashyyyk clarion]]
The '''Kashyyyk clarion''' was a horn created by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] by covering a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] horn in [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] and [[cerulean gemstone]]s. In addition to being a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument, the clarion's range of sound allowed it to be used as a communication device as well.
